Name: Travelling Skill
Author: Achtuur8
Description:
[b][size=5]Overview[/size][/b]

This mod adds a new skill to the game, Travelling. It is leveled up by simply running around. One of my biggest pet peeves with Stardew Valley is how the player gains very few upgrades to their mobility until relatively late in the game. Before unlocking the warp totems, obelisks, and return scepter, the only upgrade to mobility are minecarts and a temporary speed buff in the form of coffee.

This mod aims to change that, by including this new skill. This mod is aimed to be relatively balanced, as by default 300.000 steps are required to fully level it!

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16827/]AchtuurCore[/url].﻿
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder.
[/list]
[size=5][b]Professions[/b][/size]
[size=2]Apart from giving % movespeed every level (+1% by default), this skill also adds the following professions:
[/size]
- [i]Movespeed[/i], extra movespeed (+5% by default)
﻿- [i]Stamina Restoration[/i], restore a percentage of your stamina every 10 minutes (+1% by default)
﻿- [i]Sprint[/i], gain extra movespeed after walking for a few steps (+15% by default)
- [i]Warp Enjoyer[/i], recipes for warp totems are much cheaper
﻿- [i]Cheaper Obelisks[/i], cuts price of obelisks in half (only affects gold cost!)
﻿- [i]Totem Specialist[/i],  chance to not consume totems (50% by default)

[size=5][b]Cheaper Totem Recipes
[/b][/size][size=2]If you pick [i]Warp Enjoyer [/i](cheaper warp totems), then these are the new recipes:
[/size][list]
[*]Farm totem: 5 wood, 5 hay, 10 fiber
[*]Mountain totem: 5 wood, 1 copper bar, 10 stone
[*]Desert totem: 10 wood, 1 coconut, 10 stone
[*]Beach totem: 5 wood, 5 fiber, any 2 fish

[/list]
